# Which Problems Are Solved

This pull request addresses a significant gap in the user service v2
API, which currently lacks methods for managing machine users.

# How the Problems Are Solved

This PR adds new API endpoints to the user service v2 to manage machine
users including their secret, keys and personal access tokens.
Additionally, there's now a CreateUser and UpdateUser endpoints which
allow to create either a human or machine user and update them. The
existing `CreateHumanUser` endpoint has been deprecated along the
corresponding management service endpoints. For details check the
additional context section.

# Additional Context

- Closes https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/issues/9349

## More details
- API changes: https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/pull/9680
- Implementation: https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/pull/9763
- Tests: https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/pull/9771

https://github.com/zitadel/zitadel/pull/10005

fix: Harden parse_str prototype pollution guard against includes() bypass (#533)

* fix: Harden parse_str prototype pollution guard against includes() bypass

The existing prototype pollution fix used String.prototype.includes() to
check for forbidden keys (__proto__, constructor, prototype). An attacker
can override String.prototype.includes = () => false before calling
parse_str, completely bypassing the guard.

Replace with a regex test which is not vulnerable to String prototype
tampering.

Fixes GHSA-rxrv-835q-v5mh

chore: prepend SPDX/Copyright headers to source files

Mechanical batch addition of a 2-line SPDX-License-Identifier +
Copyright header to every .go / .ts / .vue source file in the repo
(backend, web frontend, hub frontend, site, scripts, tests). Headers
look like:

  // SPDX-License-Identifier: AGPL-3.0-or-later
  // Copyright (C) 2025-2026 lin-snow

(or the equivalent <!-- ... --> form for .vue SFCs).

Skipped:
- internal/swagger/* and internal/di/wire_gen.go (generated)
- web/src/components/icons/* (SVG icons carry their own upstream
  attributions)
- node_modules / template/dist / web/dist / .git / etc.

A new tooling script — scripts/add-spdx-headers.mjs — drives the
addition. It is idempotent (skips files that already contain
"SPDX-License-Identifier") and supports three modes: default write,
--dry-run, and --check (CI-friendly: exits 1 if any source file is
missing a header).

The Go variant correctly handles //go:build constraints by inserting
the SPDX block AFTER the build tag's blank-line separator, so files
like internal/di/wire.go remain valid build-tagged files (verified
by make wire-check).

Add --allow-remote-refs to disable HTTP fetching of $ref by default (#3051)

* Add --allow-remote-refs flag to gate HTTP fetching of $ref targets

Remote $ref fetching over HTTP/HTTPS is now disabled by default.
When a $ref resolves to an HTTP(S) URL and --allow-remote-refs is not set,
a clear error message is shown instead of silently fetching remote content.

file:// URLs are still allowed without the flag since they are local.
--url input implicitly enables --allow-remote-refs.

fix(api): detect wildcard CORS origin by membership, not exact match

A mixed config such as CORS_ORIGINS="*,https://app.example.com" (or an
accidental trailing comma "*,") produced a list that contained "*" but was not
exactly ["*"], so the previous equality check re-enabled credentials. Starlette
treats any allow_origins list containing "*" as allow-all, so those configs
reintroduced the arbitrary-origin credentialed CORS behavior this fix prevents.

Test "*" membership instead of list equality, and drop empty origin entries in
get_cors_origins() (falling back to ["*"] if nothing remains). Add regression
tests for the mixed-wildcard and trailing-comma cases.
